before.stem: Regarding the hypoglossal nerve, which of the following statements is CORRECT:
options: The hypoglossal nerve emerges from the cranial cavity via the jugular foramen.
The hypoglossal nerve innervates all of the muscles of the tongue. cy In hypoglossal nerve palsy, the tongue deviates away from the affected side on protrusion. 11%
Hypoglossal nerve palsy results in weakness of the ipsilateral tongue.
Hypoglossal nerve palsy results in loss of the gag reflex.
before.explanation: The hypoglossal nerve exits the cranial cavity through the hypoglossal canal and innervates all of the muscles of the tongue, except for the palatoglossus muscle innervated by the vagus nerve. In palsy, when protruded, the tongue will deviate towards the affected side, and is associated with weakness, wasting and fasciculations of the ipsilateral tongue. The hypoglossal nerve is not involved in the gag reflex. } Vv

after.stem: Regarding the hypoglossal nerve, which of the following statements is CORRECT:
options: The hypoglossal nerve emerges from the cranial cavity via the jugular foramen.
The hypoglossal nerve innervates all of the muscles of the tongue.
In hypoglossal nerve palsy, the tongue deviates away from the affected side on protrusion.
Hypoglossal nerve palsy results in weakness of the ipsilateral tongue.
Hypoglossal nerve palsy results in loss of the gag reflex.
warnings: Source page and external anatomy reference reviewed; remains an unapproved OCR draft.
after.explanation: CN XII exits through the hypoglossal canal, supplies the tongue except palatoglossus, and causes ipsilateral weakness with deviation toward the affected side.
after.learningNote: CN XII exits through the hypoglossal canal, supplies the tongue except palatoglossus, and causes ipsilateral weakness with deviation toward the affected side.

On examination you note when you shine a light in his right eye, neither his right or left pupil constricts. When you shine a light in his left eye, both his left and right pupil constrict. warnings: No marked correct option was detected.
